description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5320012157359 COLLAR,PIN-RIVET: Line 0001 Qty 719 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0156 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). The term of the contract/order will be one year or until the aggregate total of orders placed against the contract/order reach 350000.00. The estimated number of orders per year is 11. The Guaranteed Minimum quantity will be 71. Items will be shipped to various CONUS and OCONUS (via consolidation and containerization point) DLA Depots. Approved sources are 06725 HL1087A-8; 56878 HL1087A-8; 60516 HL1087A-8; 73197 HL1087A-8; 92215 HL1087A-8; L4528 HL1087A-8. The solicitation is an RFQ and will be available at the link provided in this notice. Hard copies of this solicitation are not available. Specifications, plans, or drawings are not available. All responsible sources may submit a quote which, if timely received, shall be considered. Quotes must be submitted electronically.
